items.title: What is 'sacredness'?
items.explanation: 'Sacredness' refers to something of deep religious or spiritual significance that is worthy of respect and reverence. In the context of this chapter, it can be a special location, shrine, or even a journey (pilgrimage) where people feel high thoughts, emotions, or devotion.

items.title: How does the land become sacred?
items.explanation: The land becomes sacred because its components—such as earth, air, water, plants, rivers, seas, and directions—are considered organs of the supreme Lord's body. This view is supported by the Bhāgavata Purāṇa.
